findings.requirement: Advancement must require the frozen population quorum and independently authenticated aggregate provenance; caller-supplied aggregates must not be able to redefine the denominator or quorum.
findings.evidence: scripts/mros/advance_program.py::_validate_aggregate validates only values supplied inside the review/audit aggregate. It accepts any positive minimum_valid_reviews/minimum_valid_audits and any positive expected/submitted counts when they are internally consistent, but it does not load or validate the frozen population manifests, aggregation policy, aggregate source hashes, or bridge receipts. A fabricated aggregate containing one syntactically plausible item with valid_reviews=expected_reviews=submitted_reviews=minimum_valid_reviews=1, decision=PASS, and no blocking counts can therefore pass this gate despite the policy requiring the frozen board population quorum (minimum_valid_reviews: 8 and corresponding audit quorum). The zero-quorum fix does not prevent under-quorum denominator laundering or fabricated aggregate authority.
findings.falsifier: Demonstrate that every production caller of authorize supplies aggregates whose quorum and denominator are cryptographically/content-addressably bound to the frozen manifests and policy, and that authorize rejects a one-item/one-quorum PASS aggregate without relying on caller-side validation.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Make advancement consume and validate the frozen review and audit population manifests and aggregation-policy quorum directly, verify aggregate provenance/content hashes and receipts, and reject aggregates whose declared counts or quorum differ from those independently derived artifacts. Add a regression test for a positive but under-quorum fabricated aggregate.
